title: 西汉 东汉（上）
subtitle: Western Han & Eastern Han - Silk Road & Culture

cards.back: land tax
cards.example: 刘邦减轻田租，让百姓休养生息。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Bang reduced land tax to let the people rest and recover.
cards.breakdown: 田：耕种的田地 · 租：用禾（禾）和且（且）表示税收

cards.back: to rest and build up strength (recovery after hardship)
cards.example: 汉朝初年，让百姓休养生息。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the early Han years, the people were allowed to rest and recover.
cards.breakdown: 休：人（亻）靠在树（木）边休息 · 养：养育 · 生：生命 · 息：呼吸、休息

cards.back: national power / strength of a country
cards.example: 到汉武帝时，西汉国力强盛。
cards.exampleTranslation: By the time of Emperor Wu, Western Han national power was strong.
cards.breakdown: 国：国家 · 力：力量

cards.back: strong and prosperous / flourishing
cards.example: 西汉国力强盛。
cards.exampleTranslation: Western Han national power was strong and prosperous.
cards.breakdown: 强：弓（弓）有力，强壮 · 盛：皿（皿）中食物丰盛

cards.back: to invade / encroach upon (territory)
cards.example: 匈奴常常进犯汉朝国土。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Xiongnu often invaded Han territory.
cards.breakdown: 进：向前走 · 犯：用犬（犭）侵犯，冲撞

cards.back: Zhang Qian (Chinese diplomat and explorer who opened the Silk Road)
cards.example: 汉武帝派张骞出使西域。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Wu sent Zhang Qian as an envoy to the Western Regions.
cards.breakdown: 张：姓张 · 骞：马（马）跑得快，千里马

cards.back: the Western Regions (areas west of the Han Empire)
cards.example: 张骞出使西域，开通了丝绸之路。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhang Qian went to the Western Regions and opened the Silk Road.
cards.breakdown: 西：西方 · 域：土（土）地上的区域

cards.back: to go on a diplomatic mission / serve as an envoy
cards.example: 汉武帝派张骞出使西域。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Wu sent Zhang Qian on a diplomatic mission to the Western Regions.
cards.breakdown: 出：出去 · 使：使者，出使的人

cards.back: to establish contact / coordinate with
cards.example: 张骞去联络大月氏共同打匈奴。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhang Qian went to establish contact with the Yuezhi to fight the Xiongnu together.
cards.breakdown: 联：连接 · 络：丝线（纟）网络，联系

cards.back: grape
cards.example: 西域的葡萄传入内地。
cards.exampleTranslation: Grapes from the Western Regions were introduced to the interior.
cards.breakdown: 葡：草字头（艹），植物 · 萄：草字头（艹），植物

cards.back: products / resources / natural produce
cards.example: 张骞报告了西域各国的物产情况。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhang Qian reported on the products of the Western Regions countries.
cards.breakdown: 物：物品 · 产：生产

cards.back: territory / land of a country
cards.example: 汉朝扩大了疆土。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Han dynasty expanded its territory.
cards.breakdown: 疆：弓（弓）和田（田）组成的边界 · 土：土地

cards.back: the Silk Road (ancient trade route connecting East and West)
cards.example: 张骞开通了丝绸之路。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhang Qian opened the Silk Road.
cards.breakdown: 丝：丝绸 · 绸：丝绸 · 之：的 · 路：道路

cards.back: West Asia
cards.example: 汉朝的丝绸运往西亚和欧洲。
cards.exampleTranslation: Han silk was shipped to West Asia and Europe.
cards.breakdown: 西：西方 · 亚：亚洲

cards.back: to interact / have dealings with
cards.example: 汉朝积极与外国交往。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Han dynasty actively interacted with foreign countries.
cards.breakdown: 交：交叉 · 往：来往

cards.back: to dismiss from office / reject
cards.example: 汉武帝时'罢黜百家，独尊儒术'。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Wu 'dismissed the hundred schools and honored only Confucianism'.
cards.breakdown: 罢：网（罒）下去，停止 · 黜：黑（黑）色被贬退

cards.back: to exclusively honor / give sole respect to
cards.example: 汉武帝独尊儒术。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Wu exclusively honored Confucianism.
cards.breakdown: 独：单独 · 尊：尊敬

cards.back: Confucianism / Confucian teachings
cards.example: 汉武帝把儒家学说作为正统思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Wu made Confucianism the orthodox ideology.
cards.breakdown: 儒：人（亻）需要的学问 · 术：学术、方法

cards.back: orthodox / legitimate / the accepted standard
cards.example: 儒家学说成为正统思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucianism became the orthodox ideology.
cards.breakdown: 正：正确 · 统：统一、系统

cards.back: the Four Books and Five Classics (Confucian canonical texts)
cards.example: 儒家的'四书五经'作为学生的课程。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Confucian 'Four Books and Five Classics' became the curriculum for students.
cards.breakdown: 四：四本书 · 书：书籍 · 五：五本书 · 经：经典

cards.back: outstanding / distinguished / eminent
cards.example: 司马迁是一位杰出的历史学家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Sima Qian was an outstanding historian.
cards.breakdown: 杰：人（亻）站在木（木）上，杰出 · 出：超出

cards.back: historian
cards.example: 司马迁是一位杰出的历史学家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Sima Qian was an outstanding historian.
cards.breakdown: 历：历史 · 史：历史 · 学：学习 · 家：专家

cards.back: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian's famous historical work)
cards.example: 司马迁写出了《史记》一书。
cards.exampleTranslation: Sima Qian wrote the book 'Records of the Grand Historian'.
cards.breakdown: 史：历史 · 记：记录

cards.back: to narrate / recount / tell
cards.example: 《史记》叙述了3000多年的历史。
cards.exampleTranslation: The 'Records of the Grand Historian' narrates over 3,000 years of history.
cards.breakdown: 叙：按照次序（余）说（讠） · 述：走（辶）着说（术）

cards.back: Liu Bang – founder of the Western Han dynasty, also known as Emperor Gaozu
Emperor Wu of Han – one of the greatest Han emperors
Xiongnu – nomadic people who frequently fought with the Han
Yuezhi – ancient Central Asian people Zhang Qian sought to ally with
Sima Qian – great historian who wrote the Records of the Grand Historian
Records of the Grand Historian – Sima Qian's masterpiece
Chang'an – capital of Western Han, modern-day Xi'an
Han people – what the Chinese were called by foreigners
Chinese language – called 'Hanyu' by foreigners
Chinese characters – called 'Hanzi' by foreigners
